prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Shanghai for work and I remember chatting with a coworker about how parking there can be such a headache.
Later on, I also heard about a weekend in Guangzhou where people were comparing what shows were on around town.
For that Shanghai trip, my colleague said they ended up using Xujiahui Grand Gateway Parking, starting at 2025-03-11 09:00, and they stayed parked for about 6 hours.
I still remember the car details they mentioned afterward—license plate was 川D78901, and the driver phone they used was 13845678901.
And in Guangzhou, a friend told me they’d already gotten a ticket for Cantonese Opera Classics—First Floor, just 1 ticket—under Luo Fei, and the contact number on it was 13899887766.
